messages:
Lena: dropped a new prototype for Usage & Billing (compact-first): left: spend sparkline, right: token breakdown + invoice row. history is inline behind a chevron accordion so you don't have to leave the page. PTAL :eyes:
Jorge: nice touch with inline history. question: where's the primary download CTA placed when accordion is collapsed?
Lena: primary Download stays on the invoice row (bottom-right). when you expand history each item has its own Download / View actions. keeps single-click for most users.
Maya: accessibility concern: chevron accordion needs clear accessible name and aria-expanded; also when history loads we should announce to screen readers. propose aria-live="polite" on the history container.
Felix: design nit: overdue badge is a small pill now showing "Overdue $XX". Suggest making the visual pill contain an icon + amount and include SR text versus color-only. Also make sure it collapses gracefully at 320px.
Jorge: token units: current mock uses 1.2M and 345k but the legend says "tokens". Can we use abbreviated units with a single-letter suffix (e.g., 1.2M -> 1.2M T) to denote tokens? Might be confusing.
Maya: prefer keeping it simple: 1.2M (tokens) in the tooltip and compact numbers in UI without extra suffix. add an explicit legend line: "Tokens (approx)" to avoid ambiguity.
Felix: copy tweak: change "View invoice" -> "Open (PDF)" and leave Download as a split action (chevron dropdown) so users can pick CSV. That reduces accidental CSV clicks. Intl teams warn on long labels.
qa-bot: accessibility checks: 1) accordion lacks aria-controls + aria-expanded; 2) overdue pill missing aria-label; 3) legend contrast ratio 3.8:1 at narrow widths (need 4.5:1); 4) keyboard nav order: download menu is after scope toggle, suggests reorder. Also recommend adding focus-visible outlines for high-contrast mode.
Lena: thanks QA. Plan: 1) add aria-expanded + aria-controls, announce panel open with aria-live, 2) overdue pill -> include visually-hidden text "Overdue: $X" and an icon, 3) bump legend text/label color for 4.5:1 at mobile breakpoints, 4) reorder DOM so keyboard flow is invoice row -> download CTA -> scope toggle -> charts.
Jorge: telemetry/experiments: let's run a 1-week 3% experiment with flag `billing.compact_inline_history`. Events to capture: `billing.find_invoice_time`, `billing.accordion_open`, `billing.download.format`. Also capture if users expand history before switching scope.
Maya: QA test matrix: VoiceOver (macOS), NVDA (Windows), ChromeVox, keyboard-only, high-contrast Windows theme, and mobile TalkBack. Include screenshots of 320px/375px/768px breakpoints.
Felix: one more UX ask: microcopy under spend chart: "Estimated monthly spend. Past invoices may include usage not shown here." slightly different wording to emphasize variance.
Lena: will update figma, add annotated diffs, and file a small localization brief for the dropdown labels. I'll post updated frames when done. Thanks all :raised_hands:
